text:
celia: FYI onboarding smoke tests failing for sampleapp-go. Looks like an auth + retry parity issue vs REST.

omar: what happened?

celia: sampleapp uses ephemeral tokens from /v1/auth/ephemeral (REST returns token + expires_in + refresh_after). Go SDK returns token but omits refresh_after and also renames expires_in -> ttl_seconds. sampleapp expects refresh_after to schedule a refresh.

frank: ugh param name drift and missing guidance. so the sampleapp doesn't refresh and hits 401s?

celia: exactly. flow: SDK issues token, sampleapp waits refresh_after then calls refresh endpoint. since SDK didn't provide refresh_after we waited too long and the running worker sent requests with an expired token. server returned 401 -> SDK retryer saw 401 and immediately retried, which triggered duplicate provisioning during onboarding.

ivy: two separate failures: (1) response shape parity (refresh_after missing + field renames), (2) retry semantics for 401 vs 429. REST clients expect 401 to be non-retriable and to trigger token refresh, but SDK treated it like a transient and retried.

ci-bot: Build #2333 failed: sampleapp-go/onboard (2026-04-02T09:12Z). Logs: https://ci.internal/builds/2333

omar: repro snippet from sampleapp logs:
```
// SDK returns
{"token": "eph_abc", "ttl_seconds": 30}
// REST returns
{"token": "eph_abc", "expires_in": 30, "refresh_after": 20}
```
Sampleapp looked for refresh_after and scheduled a refresh at t+20. Without it we only refreshed after 30 and some requests failed.

frank: also saw that when first request after expiry returned 401, SDK retryer did: retryImmediately -> second attempt succeeded but caused the downstream webhook to be processed twice. infra alerted on duplication.

token-bot: Alert: provisioning-duplicate-rate +7% detected (2026-04-02T09:13Z) in onboarding runs.

ivy: proposed fixes:
  1) SDK quick patch: on ephemeral auth responses include both shapes: expires_in and ttl_seconds, and include refresh_after if server provided it. Backfill compatibility keys for 3 months.
  2) SDK retryer change: treat 401 as non-retriable by default; instead expose a hook onAuthFailure that triggers token refresh and retries only after successful refresh.
  3) Docs/sampleapp: make sampleapp accept either ttl_seconds OR expires_in and fall back to a computed refresh_after = Math.max(5, Math.floor(expires_in * 0.7)).

omar: sounds good. timelines? this is blocking onboarding CI and sample templates used by customers.

frank: I can land the response-shape patch as a patch release today (emit both keys). The retryer change needs a minor bump because it's behavioral, add tests for refresh hook; aim for tomorrow.

celia: I'll open a sampleapp PR to accept both shapes and add the computed-refresh fallback. Also adding an integration test that simulates missing refresh_after.

ci-bot: Created tickets: SDK-1001 (ephemeral auth parity shim), SDK-1002 (retryer: onAuthFailure hook + 401 semantics), DOCS-720 (sampleapp auth fallback + migration).

ivy: extra ask: add a small changelog entry that explains fields and the recommended migration: "use refresh_after when present; otherwise compute refresh at 70% of expires_in" and callout that SDK will expose new hook. :eyes: 

frank: will include migration snippet and deprecation schedule in release notes. publishing beta for shim in ~2h.

omar: once beta is published I'll rerun CI and report back. thanks team :thumbsup:
